title: Doppel
description:
Doppel is a modern Digital Risk Protection solution that detects phishing and brand cyberattacks across channels like social media, domains, ads, and the dark web. By identifying malicious content and threats early, Doppel helps organizations proactively remove digital risks.

The integration of Doppel with OpenCTI ingests alerts from the Doppel Threat Intelligence platform as typed STIX 2.1 Observables and actionable Indicators. Customers can optionally model every processed alert as an OpenCTI Incident linked to its Observables. Imported objects are enriched with severity, entity state, platform, audit logs, and other Doppel context.
short_description: Imports Doppel Digital Risk Protection alerts as typed Observables and Indicators, with optional Incident modeling for operational alert qualification.
